data.gender_notes: Ishfaq is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: The One Who Searches, Seeks, or Longs
data.long_meaning: The one who searches, seeks or longs for something. Derived from the Arabic root sh-f-q which means to seek, long for or desire. The name Ishfaq carries the meaning “The One Who Searches, Seeks, or Longs” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Ishfaq usually hope their child will grow to embody the one who searches, seeks, or longs and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Ishfaq reflects a deep longing for the Divine and a constant search for spiritual truth. It embodies the qualities of determination, perseverance, and a strong desire to connect with the Creator.
data.etymology: Ishfaq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The One Who Searches, Seeks, or Longs.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ishfaq total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: إِشفاق
in_arabic.long_meaning: الإِشفاق من الأسماء العربية التي تشير إلى الإشراق والجود، ويأتي من الجذر الشائع في القرآن الكريم، والإِشفاق يرمز إلى الإشراق في قلوب الناس، والإِشفاق يظهر أيضاً في القرآن الكريم في سورة الشمس، وأصل الإِشفاق يعود إلى الألف والميم والقاف، والإِشفاق هو اسم من الأسماء التي لها أهمية كبيرة في الإسلام، ويتميز بالإِشفاق بالجود والإشراق، والإِشفاق يرمز أيضاً إلى الكرم والإِحسان، والإِشفاق هو اسم ينبغي أن يُختار للأطفال المسلمين الذين يحتاجون إلى الإِشراق والجود في حياتهم.
